title: Modern GEODATA DXF UnitsValue domain
scope: For GEODATA object versions 2 and 3, the DXF writer accepts horizontal and vertical unit values 0 through 24 and refuses values outside the documented UnitsValue enumeration before output mutation. Version 1's separate archival group mapping is unchanged. Parsing remains tolerant.

normativeSources.title: Autodesk GEODATA (DXF)
normativeSources.groups: Groups 91 and 92 use the UnitsValue enumeration.

normativeSources.title: Autodesk UnitsValue Enumeration
normativeSources.domain: Undefined, Inches, Feet, Miles, Millimeters, Centimeters, Meters, Kilometers, MicroInches, Mils, Yards, Angstroms, Nanometers, Microns, Decimeters, Dekameters, Hectometers, Gigameters, Astronomical, LightYears, Parsecs, USSurveyFeet, USSurveyInch, USSurveyYard, USSurveyMile; integer values 0 through 24.

implementation.behavior: dxfRW::writeGeoData validates both group-91/group-92 values in the modern v2/v3 path before output or caller-state mutation. Legacy v1 fields are unaffected.

regressionControl.coverage: For v2 and v3 in ASCII and Binary, horizontal and vertical values -1 and 25 preserve a prior output prefix and caller identity; each corrected same-writer retry uses a valid boundary value (0 or 24) and typed readback confirms both unit values. Existing valid modern writer controls use supported enum values.
regressionControl.fixturePolicy: All controls are authored locally in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

nonClaims: No physical producer or native geospatial consumer was qualified.
This does not qualify GEODATA ownership, whole-document graph closure, map projection behavior or DWG encoding semantics.
